rulings.restated: Subtract f1040 line 14 from f1040 line 11b.
rulings.model: The IRS line says "Enter the amount from your ... Form 1040 ... line 15" and to show it in parentheses if it "would have been a loss." The pages given never define Form 1040 line 15, so they don't confirm it equals line 11b minus line 14 without a floor at zero.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: interface gap; the model says the pages given never define Form 1040 line 15, so they do not confirm it equals line 11b minus line 14 without a floor at zero. The worksheet is applied to this return with each 2024 figure read as the 2025 one (amb.2025.clcw_to_2026). Line 1 is held before the zero floor, as i1040sd p. 14, Line 21 requires ("would be less than zero if you could enter a negative amount on that line"), and as amb.2025.clcw_line1_signed does for the 2024 worksheet. The identity is printed on Form 1040 (2025) p. 2, line 15: "Subtract line 14 from line 11b. If zero or less, enter -0-. This is your taxable income". That page was not given to the reviewer (only i1040sd pp. 10 and 14 and p550 p. 103 were). The English states the source correctly; the UNCLEAR is a coverage gap of the review. Same ruling as the first Stage 20 round.
